audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Irelia levels 3 and 6 and 'Skill' at 4-5, but every why/spike string on the page says Galio wins those stages (taunt flips all-ins, climbing MR, global R). The packet levelChart also lists Galio for levels 3, 4-5, 6 and first item.
audit.why: Justice Punch (E, 11/10/9/8/7s) taunts through Irelia's combo while Shield of Durand reduces incoming damage, and Galio's MR growth blunts her passive magic on-hits. Irelia only reclaims the lane at two items.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-5 flipped to Galio in both layers as one atomic group; rows 0, 1 and 6 unchanged.

audit.why: Spikes already name Vanguard's Edge, Galio's level-6 Hero's Entrance (180/160/140s) and the first-MR-item blunt; the 4-entry spikes array is complete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions never mentioned Colossal Smash (P), Galio's auto-attack reset, and the don't about Justice Punch described burning your own cooldown rather than dashing into his.
audit.why: Colossal Smash is an empowered auto with an area burst; its wind-up is the visual tell that a Galio commit is starting. Justice Punch is a 650-range dash that knocks up the first champion it meets, so Bladesurging into it hands him the engage.
audit.corrected: Report block now names Justice Punch's 11s rank-1 cooldown and the Colossal Smash reset tell; the don't now says a Bladesurge into his 650-range E gives a free knock-up.

edits.before: Track Galio's Justice Punch: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. When it is down — E-stun, Q-reset through the wave.
edits.after: Justice Punch is his engage, 11s at rank 1; his commit opens with a Colossal Smash auto reset — that wind-up is your cue to step back.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Galio must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Justice Punch taunts you while Shield of Durand cuts your damage, so he flips face-value all-ins — commit only once his E is down.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
